name: Tax Voucher 1
definition: Provides information about the tax voucher.

TaxCredit.name: Tax Credit
TaxCredit.definition: Amount of tax that have been previously paid.

TaxDeduction.name: Tax Deduction
TaxDeduction.definition: Amount of tax that have been previously deducted.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Cash amount before any deductions and allowances have been made.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Cash amount after any deductions and allowances have been made.

TaxCreditRate.name: Tax Credit Rate
TaxCreditRate.definition: Applicable tax rate on the tax credit amount.

WithholdingTaxAmount.name: Withholding Tax Amount
WithholdingTaxAmount.definition: Cash amount that will be withheld by a tax authority.

WithholdingTaxRate.name: Withholding Tax Rate
WithholdingTaxRate.definition: Rate of a cash distribution that wil be withheld by a tax authority.

ScripDividendReinvestmentPricePerShare.name: Scrip Dividend Reinvestment Price Per Share
ScripDividendReinvestmentPricePerShare.definition: Cost per share of new shares allotted.

CashAmountBroughtForward.name: Cash Amount Brought Forward
CashAmountBroughtForward.definition: Cash amount retained from previous dividend or interest payment.

AllotedSharesCost.name: Alloted Shares Cost
AllotedSharesCost.definition: Total cash amount required to purchase shares allotted.

CashAmountCarriedForward.name: Cash Amount Carried Forward
CashAmountCarriedForward.definition: Cash amount carried forward to next dividend or interest payment.

NotionalTax.name: Notional Tax
NotionalTax.definition: Where new securities are issued in lieu of a cash dividend, the notional tax is the tax on the amount of cash that would have been paid. For scrips only.

NotionalDividendPayable.name: Notional Dividend Payable
NotionalDividendPayable.definition: Amount of cash that would have been payable if the dividend had been taken in the form of cash rather than shares. For scrip only.

BargainDate.name: Bargain Date
BargainDate.definition: Date on which DRIP purchase completed.

BargainSettlementDate.name: Bargain Settlement Date
BargainSettlementDate.definition: Settlement date of the DRIP purchase transaction.

ChargeAmount.name: Charge Amount
ChargeAmount.definition: Amount of charges/fees charged to the client.

CommissionAmount.name: Commission Amount
CommissionAmount.definition: Amount due to the paying agent.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Provides information about the foreign exchange transaction.

TaxCreditOrTaxDeductionRule.definition: Either TaxCredit orTaxDeduction must be present.

TaxCreditOrTaxDeductionRuleNotBoth.definition: Either TaxCredit orTaxDeduction must be present.
